entityDescription:
As a leading telco provider, Deutsche Telekom has shaped the networking of our society for over 20 years – and knows that universal connectivity requires equally comprehensive security measures. The most effective weapon against cyberattacks is not even technology itself – but the people who work for Telekom. Their expertise about vital security architecture, its configuration and customization for customer infrastructure is what counts most. Boosting and sharing this know-how is a top priority for Telekom. In this way, it can offer future-oriented security in a connected world.
Therefore, Telekom Security was founded as a business unit within T-Systems in early 2017 – and transformed into a separate legal entity within DTAG group on July 1, 2020 (Deutsche Telekom Security GmbH or Telekom Security for short). With over 250 million euros of revenue, Telekom Security is the market leader in Germany and one of Europe’s top cybersecurity providers. 
Telekom Security addresses its customers holistically in accordance with a governance, risk & compliance approach. Its comprehensive solutions for networks, cloud services and end-customer applications give data privacy and compliance the attention they need.
Telekom Security cooperates closely with leading producers of security technology as well as innovative start-ups. Based on concrete customer demands, Telekom Security also influences further development of its partners’ products – along the entire life cycle from threat identification and protection, detection & response to recovery.
We feature differentiated solutions in combination with our Managed Services – offering customers the same highly professional services and technologies that we ourselves use to protect Deutsche Telekom worldwide. We know just how crucial security is: For example, on a single day in April 2020, we registered 48 million attacks on Deutsche Telekom’s IT infrastructure. In the same month, 5.3 trillion botnet packages were detected in the backbone of our landline and mobile networks. 
The information we collect about the respective attack vectors is stored in a database – the Telekom Threat Library, which contains many millions of entries about malware, APT attacks and zero-day exploits, and is continuously expanded to include new attack patterns. Our self-learning platform converts these patterns into indicators. All our customers automatically profit from the protection that results from this activity. 
In the course of security tests, the latest attack methods are applied and further developed. The goal is to achieve a high measure of robustness in the tested systems. This ensures the demanding level of quality we need in order to protect our own critical IT infrastructure.
These experiences and the respective, accumulated knowledge also influence Telekom’s own innovative and future-oriented software development – incorporating machine learning, artificial intelligence, protection for mobile devices, vulnerability scanning, identity management and an intelligent attack, detection and monitoring system. 
The centerpiece of our monitoring efforts is our integrated Cyber Defense & Security Operation Center (SOC) in Bonn, launched in 2017. With more than 240 employees worldwide and 24/7 availability, it is currently the biggest of its kind in Europe. All SOCs in Germany along with those in Hungary, Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Spain, Greece, South Africa, the USA, Mexico, Brazil and (new in 2019) Singapore form an international SOC network.

description: Benefit from over 20 years of research from the UCLouvain laboratories (ELEN department, ICTEAM) and multiple collaborations, VOCSens is developing a new concept of environmental camera, EnviCam®, allowing to see the invisible, these chemical and biochemical molecules surrounding us. The company has developed a manufacturing process, CMOSEnvi™, fully compatible with the CMOS technology found in the electronic chips of our daily lives. Established in February 2019, it is based at Axis Parc, Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium, close to Louvain-la-Neuve Science Park.
entityDescription:
VOCSens is a spin-off from the Sensors, Microsystems and Actuators Laboratory of Louvain (SMALL) research group, within the Electrical Engineering Department (ELEN), Institute of Information and Communication Technologies, Electronics and Applied Mathematics (ICTEAM), Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain), Louvain-la-Neuve, Belgium. UCLouvain is one of the most prestigious universities in Europe and home to worldly recognized laboratories. It relies on a strong expertise based on more than 10 years research on CMOS-compatible environmental sensors development and characterization, including gas, temperature, humidity and pressure sensors, as well as the CMOS design of read-out interfaces.

The spin-off aims to the development and commercialization of ultra-low-power low-cost multi-pixel CMOS gas microsensors dedicated to selective gases and volatile compounds detection in the Internet of Things and the Industry 4.0. The first product, EnviCam®, reflecting the concept of "environmental camera", efficiently combines gas, particulates, temperature and humidity sensors in a unique low-cost smart sensing platform featuring wireless communication through LPWAN networks. The main applications are found in environmental monitoring and industrial control (EHS, HVAC systems, alarm, etc.).

VOCSens products are pioneering in terms of autonomy, accuracy, versatility and portability, while ensuring continuous measurements in an active way, helping companies and institutions to unveil their environmental parameters, strengthen safety and health.

entityDescription:
Qaleon is a technology development company specialising in business Intelligence and Artificial Intelligence. We develop sustainable technology with purpose. Our knowledge in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Business Intelligence (BI) allows us to generate the changes with the scalability and speed that companies and society need.
We have a team of professional experts in business, technology and sustainability, ready to take your company to the next level, developing projects that benefit the entire ecosystem: the environment and society.
Our solutions help to measure, monitor and identify actions to achieve these objectives.

How We Do It
At Qaleon we guarantee data integrity and confidentiality, promoting sustainable transformation practices.

ETL process and data enrichment
At Qaleon, we collect data from all possible sources. We cleanse and structure it, laying the foundation for efficient analysis and consistent results. Data enrichment amplifies its impact by adding layers of additional information in a responsible manner, enabling sustainable transformation.

The strategic value of data enrichment
We are committed to improving the quality and relevance of data, gaining deep insights to anticipate trends, mitigate risks and improve operational efficiency.
This strategic value is reflected in the optimization of inventories, reduction of the environmental footprint, and the identification of opportunities and vulnerabilities that promote responsible practices and sustainable transformation.

Automation in the ETL Process
Automation is the driver of efficiency in the ETL process. At Qaleon, we reduce the time and errors associated with manual tasks. Automated workflows ensure consistency in data extraction, transformation and loading. This careful control minimizes the potential loss of information and reinforces the quality of the results.

Machine Learning for continuous improvement
We integrate Machine Learning techniques into the ETL process allowing dynamic adaptation to changes in data and emerging patterns. Through machine learning algorithms, we improve trend identification, forecasting and anomaly detection, providing additional intelligence to the data.

Artificial Intelligence
Artificial Intelligence takes data enhancement to new heights. Our AI algorithms not only analyze large data sets, but learn from them to make autonomous decisions, allowing us to anticipate trends, personalize experiences and proactively optimize processes.

Company description: VOLTA pioneers a groundbreaking technology enabling ZERO-VOLUME ENERGY STORAGE: Volta Structural Batteries (VSB). Our state-of-the-art multifunctional batteries serve as structural frames for spacecraft, aircrafts and trucks and virtually any transport vehicles, seamlessly integrating energy storage capabilities with their revolutionary architecture and constituent materials. VSB maximizes storable energy, power and, consequently, range within a given system without compromising the mass or volume required for passengers or cargo transport.
This groundbreaking advancement allows spacecraft ranging from 3U CubeSats to large 500+ Kg platforms to allocate 80% to 100% of the original battery pack volume to additional payload, resulting in a 40% reduction in the original battery pack mass and a 2X to 5X increase in available power.

Volta's architecture incorporates state of the art sodium-ion chemistry, the combination of this chemistry with the innovative design results in a highly advanced product with market competitive features such as:
· Higher overall system energy density;
· Fast charging: full charge in less than 15 minutes;
· High power density: maximum power output for demanding applications;
· High cycling and very long battery life, comparable with that of the systems in which it is integrated;
· High mechanical strength and stiffness: properties typical of advanced sandwich composites;
· High safety: robust safety features, even in cases of severe damage.
· High customization: panels of different shapes, sizes and thicknesses can be made according to mechanical and electrochemical requirements, and different materials can also be used for the outer layers, such as high-performance composite materials for aerospace applications or metal and plastic materials for more low-cost applications. 
Volta's solution is also engineered to be produced on a large scale at low cost due to the possibility of using existing production techniques and abundant materials, and with a manageable supply chain even at the national/European level.

entityDescription:
SpaceForest's Rocket Technologies business unit specializes in the development and deployment of advanced rocket systems, focusing on the PERUN suborbital rocket, hybrid propulsion, advanced electronics, and composite materials.

PERUN Rocket
The PERUN rocket is a single-stage, guided suborbital launch vehicle designed for carrying payloads up to 50 kg to altitudes of 150 km. It is powered by a hybrid rocket engine, which uses liquid nitrous oxide as the oxidizer and various polymers as fuel, ensuring eco-friendly operations. PERUN features advanced thrust vector control (TVC) systems for improved stability and precise flight trajectory​.
Advanced 

Rocket Electronics
SpaceForest develops sophisticated electronics for rocket applications, including tracking, telemetry, and telecommand systems. The RASEL system provides reliable real-time communication and data transmission during rocket flights. This system employs directional antennas and onboard transceivers to maintain high-bandwidth, bidirectional communication under extreme conditions.

Composite Technologies
SpaceForest is also proficient in producing high-strength, lightweight composite materials for rocket construction. These materials are essential for various rocket components, such as tubes and nozzles, offering excellent durability and performance. The company uses advanced manufacturing techniques, including tow-winding, vacuum bagging, and infusion, to create these composites, which are also designed to withstand the harsh conditions of rocket launches and re-entry​

entityDescription:
Moebeus www.moebeus.it is an Italian innovative startup and a "benefit corporation". It was founded in 2021 with the goal of promoting sustainable development and the circular economy (CE). It has established a strong partnership with the Department of Information Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at the University of Siena, in order to promote innovative strategies for that purpose. The main Moebeus’s activities are to work with associations, companies, young entrepreneurs and youth workers in order to increase their awareness about sustainability, circular economy strategies and skillls and ESG impact, trough technology. The co-founders of Moebeus are no. 4 people with specific innovation skills in different fields: the multisectoral nature of the staff's expertise represents the main added value of startup activities. Moebeus Digital skills are Moebeus Digital skills are related with cloud software application development embracing agile methodology (Scrum, SAFe) as well as smart analytics, blockchain, decision support systems, artificial intelligence and virtual/augmented reality. 
Moebeus is the owner of a patented Data Analysis tool, named BeCircular, based on smart analytics and mathematical models, which automatically aggregates data for identifying corporate positioning on ESG, SDG and circularity issues of business process, products, and services, human behaviors. BeCircular is the result of collaboration with the University's Department of Information Engineering and Mathematical Sciences in a research and development activity subject to scientific publication in the journal Procedia Environmental Science, Engineering and Management, 8 (3), 705-714 An integrated model fro supporting decision of companies in a circular and sustainable economy transition. The tool has been updated with a circular assessment inspired by Cradle to Cradle to support companies to understand and identify their degree of circularity as well as circularity strategies that the company can implement to improve the sustainability of their business.
Moebeus promotes business activities related to Blockchain, which is used by companies to certify the social and environmental commitment of the business and value chain, ensuring transparency and traceability.
Moebeus has designed a digital educating ecosystem for the empowering of young people's skills in order to consolidate their expertise in the sustainability field. The startup encourages informal and non-formal learning processes and the development of awareness of CE and in every kind of field from business to sport and wellness. Several initiatives for young people in the field of entrepreneurship and economic ethical responsibility have been promoted by Moebeus, which is active in the community of Banca Popolare Etica, part of EU Federation of Ethical and Alternative banks. It has designed educational paths for young people in some schools of Tuscany, and workshops for awareness-raising activities for local and national stakeholders. Moebeus has promoted activities for university students on circularity and technology. It is a member of the National Confederation of Crafts and Small and Medium Enterprises, and it operates in Prato within PRISMA - Prato industrial smart accelerator.

entityDescription: QLM Technology Limited is at the forefront of optical gas detection technologies, developing lidar-based imaging systems to aid tackling climate change. QLM imagers utilize quantum technology in the form of single-photon sensitive detectors, combined with spectroscopic laser measurements to detect, image and quantify fugitive gas emissions, including methane and carbon-dioxide. QLM’s sensitive gas leak detection technology is compact, low power and can be permanently deployed for 24/7 emissions monitoring. QLM offers complete solutions with automated detection and reporting of accurate, quantitative, leak data alerts.

Bimo Tech specializes in the supply of a wide range of metals and alloys, fabricated industrial equipment and components for Industry and BigScience.

Key materials for science and high-tech industry: semifinished products and customer-specific parts from: TANTALUM, NIOBIUM, ZIRCONIUM, TUNGSTEN AND TUNGSTEN ALLOYS, MOLYBDENUM AND MOLYBDENUM ALLOYS (TZM), TITANIUM AND TITANIUM ALLOYS, NICKEL-BASED ALLOYS AND SUPERALLOYS, COPPER, STEEL & STAINLESS STEEL.

We offer customized fabrication of industrial equipment (e.g. pressure vessels, heat exchangers, lifting equipment, other custom equipment and structures) and manufacturing of high-precision CNC machined components and sub-assemblies for a number of various industries and science. is a partner-centric management consulting company based in Munich. Since the company was founded in 2003, our operations have been built around three core principles: experience. involvement. return. Our client-base comprises many prominent companies from a wide range of industries.

entityDescription:
Corporate financing is a decisive factor for the success of a company, regardless of whether it is a young start-up or an established company. Solid financing is the basis for implementing future-oriented business goals and realising targeted growth plans. We understand that every company is unique and therefore requires customised solutions.

Venture capital investments are generally divided into several financing rounds, in which various co-investors usually contribute equity to the company as part of a capital increase in return for the subscription of new shares. The target companies of a venture capital investment are young and innovative companies in the start-up or growth phase.

The participation of a private equity company often takes place as part of a single transaction in which existing shares of a selling shareholder are acquired by the private equity investor. In contrast to venture capital investments, private equity investments start later and require stable cash flows.

In the first step, our experts at EurA Ventures GmbH will support you in your search for a suitable investor from our exclusive investor network as well as in finding the right investment opportunity for you. Afterwards, we support you throughout the entire transaction process right up to closing. For us, long-term, trusting and successful cooperation is important and we ensure that your individual transaction process is structured and implemented in line with your objectives.
